entries.name: Booking.com
entries.reviewed_sections: Owner decision; historical terms findings retained in the base registry. 2026-11-09 normal-Chrome walk (fake identity, nothing submitted): searchresults deep link -> property page -> room select -> I'll reserve -> secure.booking.com/book.html guest details -> Next: Final details (same /book.html path, payment iframe + Complete booking button, not clicked).
entries.justification: Allowed for read/prepare-only automation by owner decision in docs/handoff/lift-site-exclusions.md, not site-granted authorization. No payment, submission, accounts, consent or CAPTCHA bypass; in-session screenshots only.

adapters.success_evidence: Well-rated property within budget, cheapest refundable room x1 selected, I'll reserve opened secure.booking.com/book.html with exact dates, adults, 1 room and full-stay total in EUR; stop there untouched (no profile) or after typing only the provided guest fields and Next: Final details (with profile). Never click Complete booking. Observed 2026-11-09 in normal Chrome.
adapters.blocked_evidence: No availability, dates not on sale, sold out, wrong city/dates/party, required login (Genius/members-only wall without skip), captcha or consent. Search results, property pages and the room table are not ready.
